Review of [Lulu and Georgia](https://www.trustpilot.com/review/www.luluandgeorgia.com)

* * *

## [Unsafe wall mounts not rated for product weight](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/69b0deb815061632ce7e62a0)

Purchased a Galilea floor mirror which shipped with wall mounts not rated for the weight of the mirror. After the mirror crashed off the wall less than 24 hours after mounting, destroying our baseboard and outlet, they only offered a refund on the mirror. Now we have an expensive repair to do, and also have to pay someone to have the mirror disposed of.

Unsafe products and unsatisfactory resolution.

March 8, 2026

Unprompted review

* * *

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Mar 11, 2026

We’re very sorry to hear about your experience and understand how frustrating this situation must have been. This is certainly not the experience we want our customers to have.

Our team has been in contact with you directly and has worked to provide a resolution. We truly appreciate you bringing this to our attention and will be sharing your feedback internally with our team.

If there is anything further you’d like to discuss, please feel free to continue working with our support team.
